sloka: रेमिरे मुदिताः सर्वा भर्तृभिः सहिता रहः ।कृत दाराः कृत अस्त्राः च स धनाः स सुहृत् जनाः ॥१-७७-१४॥
transliteration: remire muditāḥ sarvā bhartṛbhiḥ sahitā rahaḥ ।kṛta dārāḥ kṛta astrāḥ ca sa dhanāḥ sa suhṛt janāḥ ॥1-77-14॥

translations.english: Then all the princesses paid obeisance to those worthy of worship and entered their residence that resembled the palace of Kubera.Thereafter pleased with gifting cows, riches and corn to brahmins and satisfying them they joined their husbands and enjoyed themselves in privacy
translations.hindi: यह्‌ कह्‌ राजा जनक खड़े हो गए और हाथ जोड़ कर दोनों आुनिवरों से बोले
